name: Waitlist spot
oneLiner: a white waitlist confirmation card lands on a warm lit desk: your spot number set huge on rolling odometer digits counts down as the queue of people ahead files into a green gate and your marker slides up the line, then the number lands, turns green and a Moving up chip stamps on
say: when the speaker talks about a waitlist or a queue ('thousands joined the waitlist', 'you move up every time someone gets in', 'I was number 1,284 in line'): cut in on 'waitlist', the number lands on the spot they name
